CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to content emergence/access found.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) is identified and bound to an explicit origin/status and an organization-like coordinate listing at the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to content presentation/emergence/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify represented content (colour-labeled coordinate sets) with named referents and attributes.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from content coordinate listings, distinguishing identity from provenance/organization.

O.rationale: The report gives explicit organized coordinate listings and structured candidate/current records, indicating how contents are presented/organized.
